trends.name: Iran-Israel Escalation & Oil Shock
trends.summary: Iran conducted drone strikes on Israeli defense sites including Elbit Systems and Iron Dome facilities; Revolutionary Guard downed US MQ-9 drones. Brent crude surging to record monthly gains with WTI above $100/barrel for first time since 2022. Geopolitical risk driving broad market selloff with S&P 500 futures down 100+ points and international stocks (-11%) worst month since March 2020.

trends.name: Market Selloff & Worst Month Since COVID
trends.summary: Global equity markets tracking worst month since March 2020 with ACWI down -9% and international stocks ACWX down -11%. Nasdaq on pace for second 3-day streak of 1%+ declines in 2026; S&P 500 futures erasing pre-market gains. Multiple momentum signals suggesting further downside risk ahead.

trends.name: Oil Supply Concerns & Strait of Hormuz
trends.summary: Iran-Israel tensions threatening Strait of Hormuz shipping lanes with China suppliers warning of higher prices for Americans. Iranian Oil Minister claims fuel supply measures adequate, but market skepticism high. Oil shock potentially persistent rather than temporary, challenging Fed's dovish inflation narrative.

trends.name: Semiconductor Sector Underperformance
trends.summary: Micron stock sinks 10% in post-earnings selloff. Software outperforming semiconductors by 500bps (rare event, 0-2 times in 3 months), signaling rotation away from chip stocks. Market reassessing AI hardware demand amid broader tech selloff.

trends.name: Sysco $29B Restaurant Depot Acquisition
trends.summary: Sysco completing $29 billion buyout of family-owned Restaurant Depot to dominate US food service distribution for restaurants, hospitals, and schools. Major M&A consolidation play in food service sector reflecting industry consolidation trends and cash-and-carry model expansion.

trends.name: Fed Policy & Powell's Inflation Assessment
trends.summary: Fed Chair Powell signals inflation outlook remains in check with no need to hike rates despite oil shock. However, market skepticism growing as oil prices surge 50%+ in a month—potentially contradicting Fed's transitory narrative and pressuring rate-cut expectations.

trends.name: AI Stock Selection & Enterprise Software
trends.summary: BofA identifies specific AI growth stocks as 'the place to be' amid broader tech selloff. Plexo CEO disputes narrative that AI will completely replace enterprise software, suggesting market overcounting disruption risk. Software outperformance vs semiconductors reflects sector-level AI opportunity reassessment.

trends.name: US Geopolitical Overreach Concerns
trends.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry and Zelensky messaging American aggression concerns; Trump declines to rule out ground troops in Middle East. Geopolitical tensions expanding beyond Israel-Iran to Ukraine-Russia, with Iran warning removal of US forces from region. Market concerned about expanding US military commitments.

trends.name: Housing Market & Economic Pain Ahead
trends.summary: Analysis suggests housing market pain 'just beginning' for US economy with mortgage costs pressuring affordability. HSAs being promoted as healthcare affordability workaround, but complexity remains. Broader economic slowdown signals building with consumer pressures mounting.

trends.name: Corporate Earnings & Valuation Reality Checks
trends.summary: Mixed earnings season with Progress Software, Micron, and others delivering results; Sysco, Badger Meter, Connect Biopharma, and Corcept among notable movers. Market reassessing growth assumptions and tech valuations amid macro headwinds and sector rotation away from high-multiple names.

trends.name: Retirement Savings Rule Dies Again
trends.summary: Fiduciary protection rule for retirement savers has died for second time, creating regulatory uncertainty for investors. Impacts adviser accountability and retirement planning landscape with potential for increased conflicts of interest.

trends.name: SpaceX & OpenAI IPO Fast-Track Listing
trends.summary: Nasdaq paving way for SpaceX and OpenAI to quickly join premier index after IPO completion, signaling confidence in AI/space unicorn valuations. Reflects market's continued bullish view on private-to-public AI/tech transitions despite near-term macro stress.
